sop_thesis: **Cricut (CRCT)** operates in Technology (Industrial Machinery/Components) with an established market capitalization of $1.40B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Semiconductor Microarchitecture, Proprietary Software & Design IP. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $7.91 (18.1% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $6.57 (Tranche 1), $6.16 (Tranche 2), and $5.7 (Tranche 3).
